# Birdwatching Log Skill for Muse

Gets you started birding from exactly where you are: a likely-species list for your region and season, ID prompts with the field marks and calls that separate confusing look-alikes, a realistic beginner gear-and-timing note (binoculars help, a phone works), and a lightweight life-list format to log species, date, and place. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: it points you to a live ID app to confirm any specific sighting — treat its species lists as a starting guide for your area, not a field guide replacement. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
